tasks.title: Develop product and account management features
tasks.description: Implement CRUD functionality for products and customer accounts for store owners and sales personnel.

tasks.title: Implement customer browse and cart functionality
tasks.description: Develop browse functionality for guests and cart management for registered customers.

tasks.title: Implement order submission flow
tasks.description: Enable order creation for signed-in users, enforcing authentication and non-empty cart constraints.

tasks.title: Execute user acceptance testing
tasks.description: Perform testing of the browse-cart-order flow for the single-store deployment.

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has an empty shopping cart
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer attempts to submit the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the submission and does not create an order

source.quote: An empty cart cannot be submitted.

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in customer with items in their cart
acceptance_criteria.then: the system creates one order and displays a unique order reference

source.quote: A successful submission creates one order containing the selected items and quantities and displays its reference.

acceptance_criteria.when: the user attempts to place an order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system requires the user to sign in

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in but must sign in before placing an order.
The Product Owner is accountable for specification acceptance and user acceptance testing.
The Business Analyst is responsible for preparing the specification.
The Full-stack Developer is accountable for implementation and deployment.
The Full-stack Developer makes technical implementation decisions, develops the application, and deploys releases.
The QA Engineer is accountable for test execution.
The QA Engineer prepares and executes tests, records defects, and reports whether the release meets the agreed acceptance criteria.
A sales representative acts as a business stakeholder, explains day-to-day sales workflows, and participates in user acceptance testing.
